about.title: About me
about.bio: I studied Media Arts at the Bauhaus-Universität Weimar, where I fell in love with stop motion, and spent eight years animating for brands at Camera Medica. Along the way I got curious about what happens behind the screen, so I learned to code. Today I design and animate learning content at eduBITES and build the tools and AI pipelines that let a small team make more without losing the craft.

timeline.title: From keyframes…
timeline.y2010: Media Arts at Bauhaus Weimar. Paper, clay and a camera. Stop motion was my first love.
timeline.y2014: Camera Medica. Started as video specialist, stayed eight years as motion designer. Hundreds of client projects.
timeline.y2022: Curious about what happens behind the screen. Learned to code with Oracle ONE and Ironhack.
timeline.y2024: eduBITES. Scripts, animation, interactive lessons and the company website.
timeline.y2026: Creative Technologist. Building the pipelines that connect motion, code and AI.

motion.intro: Animation is where I started and what I keep coming back to. I like trying different ways of making things move, from paper and clay to keyframes, 3D and AI, and mixing them to see what comes out.

web.title: Built for the web
web.intro: I learned web development to build my ideas myself, not only design them. Since then I keep finding better ways to build: lighter pages, cleaner code and small automations that save hours.

web.decrypterLine: Turns a message into code and back again.

pipelines.aria: Automated YouTube pipeline: topic, script, voice, frames, edit, captions, upload, YouTube, analytics, comments, then back to topic
pipelines.title: …to pipelines.
pipelines.flow: The Bias Gap · automated YouTube channel
pipelines.intro: The Bias Gap is a side project. I wanted to see how far one person could take a YouTube channel, so I built the whole pipeline with free tools, from picking a topic to pinning comments. It runs the channel for me, and I only step in to approve each video.
pipelines.aa: A ScriptUI panel for After Effects. One click adds entrances, exits, elastic scale, fades and subtle camera moves to any layer. Built with expressions, so animations adapt when you trim. Also sequences, precomposes and copies the current frame.
pipelines.srt: Load a voiceover transcript (.srt) and a cut sheet, and it places every image layer where its line is spoken. An hour of manual timing becomes one click.

desc.topic: Pick a bias from the backlog, ranked by what performs
desc.script: Write the short script in markdown
desc.voice: Generate the voiceover with a cloned voice
desc.frames: Generate the shots in Google Flow
desc.upload: Upload with title, description and schedule

automation.title: Automation
automation.intro: Plugins I built for After Effects, made to measure for recurring projects. They take the repetitive steps out of the workflow, so more time goes into the parts that need a human eye.
